and burst from the fragrant abyss where they rest. Colors, too, colors upon colors, emerge clear as day from the fertile ground where every flower and leaf is wet with pearls of dew. The world about me has become a Paradise! Look up! Up there! Already mighty peaks announce that most solemn of hours! They are the first to enjoy the eternal light that later makes its way down to us. And now the upper meadows are agleam with brilliant clarity in all their greenness, and step by step the slow descent is concluded— and out comes the sun! Ah, and dazed already by its radiance, I turn aside my eyes from his painful glare. Is it ever otherwise? When with a keen desire we have struggled our way up to the supreme moment, and find the gates of fulfillment flung wide, we are met by a burst of flame from eternal depths that leaves us standing confounded. Our aim was to light life’s torch, and an ocean surge of fire engulfs us. And what a fire it is! Is it love, is it hate, this fire that swirls around us, alternating pain and joy beyond endurance, driving us back to earth again to hide in the misty veils of early youth? Well— then let the sun remain at my back. I look and I see with greater and greater delight

从他们休息的芬芳深渊中冲出。颜色也是如此，颜色上的颜色，从肥沃的土地上清晰地浮现出来，那里的每一朵花和叶子都沾满了珍珠般的露珠。我周围的世界变成了天堂！抬头！上面！雄伟的山峰已经宣告了最庄严的时刻！他们是第一个享受永恒之光的人，而永恒之光后来又降临到我们身上。现在，上面的草地在绿色中闪烁着明亮的光芒，缓慢的下降一步一步结束了——太阳出来了！啊，我已经被它的光芒弄晕了，我把目光从他痛苦的目光中移开。难道有别的情况吗？当我们带着强烈的愿望奋力到达至高无上的时刻，并发现实现之门敞开时，我们会遇到来自永恒深处的一阵火焰，让我们感到困惑。我们的目标是点燃生命的火炬，然后汹涌的火海吞没了我们。那是一场多么大的火灾啊！是爱，是恨，这团在我们周围盘旋的火焰，令人难以忍受的痛苦和欢乐交替着，驱使我们再次回到尘世，躲在青春的薄雾里？好吧——那就让阳光留在我的背上吧。我越看越高兴
